text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: P1 alert — SmartRouting feedback loop detected for prod-us-west. Error spike + cascading failovers. Root thread ts 1716004321

alice-prod: I'm paged, jumping in. Ben / Carla you're oncall? please ack.

ben-pager: acked. joining. what's the impact?

incident-bot: summary: 3x increase in 5xx for route /v1/generate (prod-us-west). Observed repeated region failovers from us-west -> us-east and back, and a surge in client retries. Top-affected customers: AcmeCorp (latency >5s), BetaApps (timeouts). Autoscaler thrash + model-load OOMs on fallback variants.

carla-sre: root cause hint: routing fallback policy allows alias fallback across model family. fallback chooses alias "compatible-legacy" which maps to v2-q4 while primary is v3-fp16. When v3 pool is under pressure, fallback triggers model loads of v2-q4 that aren't cache-compatible -> KV cache misses and immediate failovers.

ben-pager: that's creating double traffic: client retries hit prod-us-west, failing, are routed to us-east, which then fails and routes back. Client retry logic with no jitter -> thundering herd.

model-oncall: confirmed — change merged in yesterday's rollout added alias mapping for "latest-stable". Policy condition for cross-variant fallback was unintentionally broad.

alice-prod: immediate mitigation plan (T-0):
- disable cross-variant fallback for prod regions (set fallback mode = strict)
- apply edge-level retry throttling (add jitter + cap)
- pin active sessions to original variant where possible
- notify CS and affected customers

carla-sre: I'm executing policy change now:
```
PUT /api/configs/smart-routing/prod-us-west
{ "fallback": "strict", "rollout": "manual" }
```

deploy-bot: policy update accepted, propagation starting (approx 30s).

ben-pager: also applying edge rule to reduce retry amplification: set client-facing proxy to enforce backoff: maxRetries=2, baseDelay=100ms, jitter=uniform(0,100ms). Pushing rule.

infra: autoscaler group for fallback pool is paused to avoid further thrash. We're also killing runaway model loads on ephemeral nodes.

maria-cs: drafting customer note for AcmeCorp and BetaApps. Will include mitigation steps and ETA for full verification.

alice-prod: quick impact assessment: approx 8-12% of requests for enterprise plans in us-west experienced elevated latency or 5xx during the window. No data exfiltration. Monitoring shows error rate dropping as policy propagates.

ben-pager: collecting logs: model load stack shows OOMs and mismatch exceptions referencing "quantized-v2" adapters. I'll paste snippets to the incident doc.

carla-sre: added temporary Grafana panel for failover loop metrics (failovers/sec, model_loads/sec, retry_rate). Sending link in #eng-ops.

model-oncall: post-mitigation action: roll back alias change or make alias restricted to compatible families. I'll prepare a short patch to tighten alias resolution semantics.

alice-prod: plan for full resolution:
1) keep fallback strict for next 2 hours while we observe
2) tighten alias mapping and release a patch to model catalog (model-oncall)
3) add routing policy unit tests to catch cross-family fallback (carla)
4) improve proxy retry jitter defaults (infra/ben)
5) customer follow-up and incident postmortem (maria/alice)

ben-pager: handoff: I'm on for 4 hours then handing to derek-sre. Derek you good to take next watch?

derek-sre: ack, I'll take after 4h. please share any remaining runbook items.

maria-cs: sent initial message to AcmeCorp and BetaApps: "We've applied mitigations and are monitoring. We'll update within 2 hours with full postmortem."

carla-sre: monitoring shows failovers/sec back to baseline, model_loads/sec dropped 84%, client retry rate decreased 70%. Latency median returned to ~120ms.

incident-bot: Incident status: mitigated. Please continue monitoring for 2h before declaring resolved.

alice-prod: thanks team. I'll kick off the postmortem doc and action items. High-priority items assigned: alias resolution tightening, routing policy unit tests, default client retry jitter.

ben-pager: logging final notes into oncall-runbook and linking artifacts (logs, diffs, grafana snapshots).

derek-sre: will validate with smoke tests on failover scenarios during my shift.

incident-bot: incident RESOLVED (mitigation successful). last observed improvement noted at thread end ts 1716006450. :white_check_mark:
